title: Small cobwebs
description: Makes cobwebs smaller and less obstructive while keeping the vanilla Minecraft style.
body:
Makes cobwebs smaller and less obstructive while keeping the vanilla Minecraft style.
Perfect for cleaner builds, better visibility, and a less annoying look in caves, mineshafts, and PvP situations.

**Features**
- Smaller cobweb model
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Better visibility
- Works in survival and creative
- Lightweight resource pack
